parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door and base, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and alignment.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds the other components together.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of plywood. It ensures stability and weight distribution.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of stored items and keeps the cabinet stable on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is the front panel of the cabinet, made of MDF, with a handle for opening and closing.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet’s interior and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close, allowing access to the cabinet interior.
